name: control_hud
description: Control the HUD widgets displayed on the home screen. Use this when the user asks to open, close, show, hide, or manage widgets. Commands: 'open' adds a widget, 'close' removes a widget, 'clear' removes all widgets, 'reset' restores the default layout. IMPORTANT: The 'map' widget is a small HUD minimap overlay — it is NOT the full map page. For full map/navigation requests use map_command instead.

parameters.description: The HUD action to perform. Use 'open' to add a widget. Use 'close' to remove a specific widget. Use 'clear' to remove all widgets. Use 'reset' to restore the default layout.

The widget to open or close. Required for 'open' and 'close' commands. Options include clock, system, network, music, map, suit, text, pdf, image, terminal, agenda, todo, stocks, headlines, timer, weather-radar, camera-feed, transcript, uptime, orbit, calculator.
When command is 'open' and widget is 'text', the body text to display. Extract the text the user wants shown.
When command is 'open' and widget is 'pdf', the document location: a full https URL, a path under public (e.g. /brochure.pdf), or an absolute file path.
When opening the 'text' widget, an optional short header title, e.g. 'REMINDER', 'NOTE'. Ignored for other widget types.
